usage: Used to refer to a group that includes the speaker
Can mean we as a subject or us as an object depending on context
Very common in everyday spoken Cantonese

examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 heoi3 sik6 faan6
ngo5 dei6 ji5 ging1 zeon2 bei6 hou2
lou5 si1 giu3 ngo5 dei6 zou2 di1 dou3
examples.meaning: The teacher told us to arrive earlier.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 zoi3 gin3 laa1
examples.meaning: We’ll see each other again tomorrow.
